appearance.silhouette: 한쪽 눈이 희게 흐리고 귀 끝에 붉은 실이 꿰인 큰 산늑대
appearance.visualIdentity: 크고 마른 근육질 산늑대. screen-left 눈의 흰 혼탁과 screen-right 귀 끝에 꿰인 짧은 붉은 실 한 가닥이 무리 우두머리 표식이며 야생 동물 체형을 유지한다.
appearance.equipmentLock: 별도 인공 무기는 없다. 붉은 실은 screen-right 귀 끝에 정확히 1가닥만 있고 목걸이, 갑옷, 안장, 뿔은 없다.

style.profile: ProjectBS rough low-density open-ink mok-seon pastel
style.linework: rough sparse near-black open ink contour
style.color: restrained low-density cold gray-brown pastel wash

singleImageSpecification.pose: neutral alert full-body quadruped stance, all four paws and tail visible
singleImageSpecification.framing: centered complete animal silhouette with safe empty margins; no crop

requiredElements: screen-right 귀 끝의 짧은 붉은 실 정확히 1가닥
prohibitedElements: 표식 좌우 반전 또는 붉은 실 증식
인공 무기, 갑옷, 목걸이, 안장, 뿔
실존 역사 인물 또는 문양 재현

phases: f0 low alert quadruped ready with all four paws readable
f1 hindquarter compression and shoulder lowering
f2 short grounded drive begins with head tracking screen-right
f3 neck and torso extend into melee range while forepaws remain anatomically coherent
f4 one fast decisive bite impact, jaws close once and tail balances the body
f5 immediate release with no repeated bite
f6 paws recover under the torso and head retracts
f7 stable alert ready-compatible recovery
animationRequests.motion: single fast close-range leader bite derived from the basic skill; force connects hind legs, pelvis, spine, shoulders, neck and jaws; no leap across the cell and no repeated mauling
anatomyMarkLocks: exactly four legs and four paws in every frame
cloudy white screen-left eye remains screen-left
exactly one short red thread remains on screen-right ear
teeth and claws are natural anatomy
no artificial weapon, armor, collar, saddle, horn, duplicated limb, tail, eye mark, or thread
animationRequests.styleEffects: short body-attached broken black/charcoal dry-brush compression at shoulders and jaws during f3-f5 with sparse cold gray-brown pastel pressure; no blood spray, magic, aura, detached trail, clean vector swoosh, or cell crossing

phases: f0 left-leading fore/hind contact pair
f1 left-leading compression
f2 extended passing with opposite limbs advancing
f3 gathered airborne phase
f4 right-leading fore/hind contact pair opposite f0
f5 right-leading compression opposite f1
f6 opposite extended passing
f7 second distinct gathered airborne phase closing into f0
animationRequests.motion: fast screen-right elite wolf pursuit at movement scale 1.5 with coherent quadruped gait, flexing spine, planted push-off, shoulder/hip opposition and tail counterbalance; game root fixed, no camera pan
anatomyMarkLocks: four legs remain anatomically distinct and alternate correctly
cloudy screen-left eye and one red thread on screen-right ear never swap
no whole-body mirror, species drift, extra limb, collar, armor, saddle, horn, or artificial weapon
animationRequests.styleEffects: restrained body-attached broken ink echoes behind paws, spine and tail during extension only; sparse grounded cold gray-brown pastel pressure; no detached speed trail, floor cloud, attack arc, magic, or neighboring-cell effect

phases: f0 four-paw alert stance
f1 shallow ribcage inhale and ear attention
f2 small weight shift through forepaws and shoulders
f3 exhale with slight tail counter-settle
f4 brief screen-right pack scan without howling or stepping
f5 ear thread, fur masses and tail settle cleanly into f0
animationRequests.motion: living restrained pack-leader idle with all paws grounded, subtle breathing, gaze, ears and tail response; not a bite anticipation, howl activation, walk-in-place, or dramatic pose
anatomyMarkLocks: exactly one red thread on screen-right ear
no mirror, mark swap, duplication, disappearance, species substitution, collar, armor, saddle, or horn
animationRequests.styleEffects: almost none; at most tiny body-attached broken settling marks that vanish by f5; no aura, howl wave, persistent glow, floor effect, magic, or neighboring fragment

combat.roleIntent: 굶주린 짐승 무리를 이끄는 엘리트 야수. 회피형 산길 또는 포위전에서 압박을 강화한다.

skills.name: 무리 울음
skills.intent: 짧은 시간 주변 짐승의 돌입 압박을 높이는 의도.

notes: 핵앤슬래시 다수 몬스터 전투 기준으로 공격 스코어 50%, 체력 스코어 25% 보정 적용. NPC 기본 회복 스탯은 사용하지 않는다.
